items.title: Deutsche Bank's Crypto Custody Launch
points: Major European bank Deutsche Bank has activated its cryptocurrency custody offering, providing institutional-grade secure storage (safekeeping of private keys/digital assets on behalf of clients) for digital assets

The service addresses a key barrier to institutional crypto adoption: large financial institutions and funds need trusted custodians to safely hold cryptocurrencies before committing significant capital
This move follows years of crypto industry development of custody solutions and represents validation from a globally recognized traditional financial institution with deep regulatory relationships

items.title: Visa Blockchain Settlement Expansion
points: Monad becomes the 10th blockchain on Visa's stablecoin settlement network (a system for finalizing stablecoin-based payments), joining Ethereum, Solana, Base, Polygon, Avalanche, Stellar, and others
Settlement volume reached $20 billion annualized run rate as of September, up 15x year-over-year, with 225 stablecoin-linked card programs live worldwide
Monad's institutional privacy feature, launching soon, keeps transaction details confidential while remaining auditable by regulators and maintaining public chain liquidity
Weekend and holiday settlement capability distinguishes blockchain rails from traditional five-business-day banking schedules

items.title: Tokenized Securities Venues and Stock Token Trading
points: SEC's September 2026 Innovation Exemption created a new Tokenized Securities Venues (TSV) category allowing automated market makers (AMMs, smart contracts that let users trade tokens without a traditional order book) on public blockchains to trade tokenized stocks without exchange or Alternative Trading System registration
Uniswap has processed over $20 billion in stock token volume; Robinhood Chain generated $900 million across 130,000 wallets in three months via 40+ SPY-paired pools

TSV compliance requires Know-Your-Limits and Know-Your-Customer identity verification, per-pool disclosures, and price oracles (services that feed real-world price data to smart contracts) tied to real exchanges, all implementable via Uniswap v4 hooks (programmable smart contract filters)
Five-year exemption targets the $79 trillion US equities market, where atomic blockchain settlement is final compared to T+1 (one business day) clearinghouse cycles in traditional markets

items.title: Hyperliquid's Liquidity Moat Erosion
points: November 2025 to November 2026 orderbook analysis shows Hyperliquid's long-tail dollar depth (available trading liquidity for less-popular assets) fell 82% versus 61% on Binance and 78% on OKX across 38 comparable markets

After controlling for token price declines, the Hyperliquid-to-Binance depth ratio dropped 57.5% at 5 basis points (0.05% price movement); $10k execution costs now 5.21 basis points on Hyperliquid versus 2.95 on Binance
Wintermute's monopolization of read priority fees (ability to see order book first) and L1 chain congestion at 25,000-40,000 transactions per second disadvantaged smaller market makers

Smaller market makers responded by widening spreads and reducing depth to manage adverse selection risk (losses from trading against better-informed counterparties), eroding the competitive differentiation that attracted long-tail traders

items.title: DeFi Moats in the AI Era
points: AI tooling has collapsed DeFi (decentralized finance, blockchain-based financial services without traditional intermediaries) product launch costs from six-month, $3 million builds to weekend projects, but commoditization strengthens incumbent protocol moats rather than eroding them
Financial moats—liquidity depth, customer trust, proprietary risk underwriting—require years to accumulate and sit beyond what AI can replicate from scratch
AI agents are emerging as the next sophisticated user class, gravitating toward protocols with deepest liquidity and most reliable execution at scale rather than software feature competition

Protocols like Uniswap, Aave, and Hyperliquid positioned as primary beneficiaries as decentralized exchange market share against centralized exchanges hits all-time highs and institutional tokenized asset adoption accelerates

items.title: Novig Sports Prediction Contracts Ruling
points: Federal judge rejected Novig's injunction against New York, ruling sports prediction contracts are gambling not swaps, requiring licenses or state compliance

items.title: Alta's Onchain Corporate Finance Infrastructure
points: Alta raises funding to build onchain corporate finance infrastructure addressing $4T in trapped cash and $1.4T counterparty risk globally
